neighbours.label: Noun phrases that sum up everything or the effect of something: 'all that X has to offer', 'the best X has to offer', 'the difference X makes', 'different forms of': a list, the pattern is unclear
fire: Visitors can sample all that Venice has to offer in three days.
This guide covers the best the region has to offer.
Students soon see the difference a good teacher makes.
Few people grasp the difference one vote makes.
The course surveys different forms of government in history.
Lawyers compare different forms of contract in the seminar.
The shop stocks the best the valley has to offer.
You will notice the difference a new mattress makes.
quiet: Visitors can sample the local food of Venice in three days.
This guide covers the roads of the region in detail.
Students soon see the value of a good teacher.
Few people grasp the rules of the vote.
The course surveys the history of government in Europe.
Lawyers compare long lists of contract terms in the seminar.
The shop stocks the fruit of the valley all year.
You will notice the smell of a new mattress.

short: 'the best X has to offer', 'the difference X makes'
notes: Card: ' role' x8, ' form' x6, ' forms' x3, ' worst', ' best', ' difference', 'all that', ' has'. Probe: ' difference' 0.92, ' forms' 0.87, ' has' in 'has to offer' 0.77-0.83, ' worst' 0.33, but ' role' in 'an important role' 0.00, against the card. Plain alternatives at most 0.05. I found no single pattern, and ' role' is not covered.
